entity.title: Entity Viewer
entity.charHint: Pick a class/animation to list the armor and weapon combos that actually exist for that class; changing one decodes and plays immediately.
entity.monsterHint: Monsters are enumerated from monstdat animation letters (Stand/Walk/Attack/Hit/Death/Special); selecting one decodes and plays it, with the direction count taken from the decode result.
entity.npcHint: NPCs are single-direction .cel sprites (including the hardcoded towners/animals/cow.cel); selecting one decodes and plays it.

combat.title: Skill / Combat Viewer (single screen: player + monster + all stages)
combat.hint: The Direction slider rotates the whole encounter around the caster: the target lands in the caster's facing direction and turns back to face the caster, with both positions and facings recomputed together. All four stages play within the current direction; playback never switches direction. Play walks cast -> projectile -> impact -> debuff; the stage buttons inspect a single stage; debuff tints the target via TRN.

scene.title: Scene Viewer (scene.list / scene.build · complete isometric level)
scene.archive: MPQ path (optional, overrides the catalog's primary archive)
scene.archivePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the discovered archive stack
scene.dirtToggle: Draw Dirt border (faithful dPiece, may cover the room)
scene.hint: Pick a scene -> loads immediately: the backend uses DevilutionX's two-pass draw (floor diamonds + walls) to reconstruct the complete scene, returning a PNG preview plus an aligned overlay. Drag to pan, use the dropdown or the wheel to zoom (0.25×/0.5× for a whole-map preview; zoom keeps the map centre). Toggling Lighting reuses the backend cache for the lit/unlit results. Red=Solid, Blue=transparent, Yellow=BlockLight. "Clear map cache" deletes generated scene images and forces a rebuild next time.

gui.title: GUI Layout Viewer (ui.list / ui.build · real MPQ art composite)
gui.archive: MPQ path (optional, overrides the primary archive)
gui.archivePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the discovered archive stack
gui.hint: Backend ui.build composites REAL MPQ art (background PCX / panel CEL / health & mana orbs / button CLX) at DevilutionX coordinates into a 640×480 base image, plus an aligned element-box overlay PNG. Text is drawn by the frontend with a system font from the layout fields (approximate, not the game's original bitmap font; toggle it off to inspect the pure art). Pick an element from the Element dropdown to see its type / rect / referenced art / source location below and highlight its box on screen; mouse hover is no longer used.
gui.infoPrompt: Pick an element from the dropdown above to see its details…
